== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Communing (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (<code>1273_33</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-communing-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Communing.png]]) print PC-E2 ([[Communing (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT”, 23 June 2011 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If your starting location has exactly two [Light Side], play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; ▲ and stack a Jedi here. Luminous Beings: Whenever a Jedi is lost (or placed out of play) from table, may stack it here. Jedi stacked here are 'communing' and considered out of play. You generate +1 Force for each card stacked here. I Can't Believe He's Gone is canceled. Once per turn, if two cards here, may use 1 Force to look at top card of Reserve Deck, Force Pile, and/or Used Pile; return one card to each deck or pile.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1273_33</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block set mark, copyright line, Special Edition sphere and errata mark E as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB7-00-Communing-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B12 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
